AsyncSemaphore.luau.description: Limits the number of asynchronous operations running concurrently. Waiting callers receive permits in FIFO order. Public entry points include `AsyncSemaphore.new`, `AsyncSemaphore.GetMaxConcurrency`, `AsyncSemaphore.SetMaxConcurrency`, `AsyncSemaphore.GetActiveCount`, `AsyncSemaphore.GetAvailableCount`, `AsyncSemaphore.GetWaitingCount`, `AsyncSemaphore.TryAcquire`, `AsyncSemaphore.AcquireAsync`.

AsyncSemaphorePermit.luau.description: Represents one acquired [AsyncSemaphore] permit. Releasing a permit is idempotent, and the permit may be given directly to a [Maid]. Public entry points include `AsyncSemaphorePermit.new`, `AsyncSemaphorePermit.Release`, `AsyncSemaphorePermit.IsReleased`, `AsyncSemaphorePermit.Destroy`.
